title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.

title: December Pookal
desc: Annam Poornima, a journalist, is in love with Chandru, an artist who tragically lost his wife. However, a police officer suspects Annam may be the next victim of a serial killer.

title: Mr. Madras
desc: An industrialist hires a young man to settle her disputes with a local criminal on her behalf.

title: Mullil Roja
desc: A love triangle occurs between a poor village dancer, her husband who is a reformed drunkard, and her former lover who turns mentally unstable.

title: Thayagam
desc: Three escaped felons hijack a plane carrying a scientist, but the pilot lands in Kashmir. Later, chaos unfolds when a terrorist hunts them down, seeking the scientist.
